mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_auth ( email, auth_code, verified, expires_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{authCode}, #{verified}, #{expiresAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, auth_code AS authCode, verified, DATE_FORMAT(expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expiresAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM email_auth WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE email_auth SET verified = 'N', updated_at = NOW() WHERE email = #{email}
UPDATE email_auth SET verified = 'Y', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
